limitations: Calibration and later-period evaluation use the same frozen April-eligible product cohort.
The source ends on 2011-12-09, so this evaluation is not evidence of current retail performance.
Earlier exploratory work examined some dates and subsets in these periods; do not describe the later-period results as a pristine blind benchmark.
